description: This Java class 'InlineCOBLoanItemReader' extends 'AbstractLoanItemReader' and is used within a Spring Batch context for processing loans in the context of Coast of Business (COB) batch jobs. It initializes remaining loan data based on job execution context.

classes.name: InlineCOBLoanItemReader
classes.description: A Spring Batch item reader tailored for handling loan data during COB processing, utilizing a loan repository and job execution context.

methods.name: InlineCOBLoanItemReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the reader with a loan repository.

methods.name: beforeStep
methods.description: Method annotated with @BeforeStep to initialize the remaining loan data from the job execution context before batch step execution.
